name: Sylvia Ikaruga Misurugi
original_name: シルヴィア・斑鳩・ミスルギ
source: The youngest daughter of the Misurugi royal empire's family and Ange and Julio's younger sister. She used to admire her sister until she was revealed to be a Norma. Due to her being a paraplegic, she uses a mana powered floating chair to move around.
